experiment: Phase 1 — falsifiable claim injection per candidate
what_changed_from_phase0: Every auto-generated lean skeleton now commits to a `no_zero_in T_lo T_hi` claim with deterministic-per-candidate window in [10, 101].
Odlyzko benchmark scores: -0.50 if window contains a known zero; +0.20 if window inside table range AND empty; 0 otherwise.
Result: 19 candidate claims FALSIFIED across all 3 arms — first real adversarial signal in the apparatus.
honest_finding_about_klein: Klein topology has the highest factual error rate of the three modes (11.25% claims contradicted by Odlyzko vs 6.25% for baseline). The K-novelty surface_return + obstruction_cycle artifacts add candidates whose auto-generated claim windows happen to straddle real zeros more often. This is empirical, not a bug — Klein's added candidate diversity comes with a higher wrongness rate.
honest_finding_about_hyperloop: Hyperloop wins external Odlyzko (0.4917 vs klein 0.3725, lift +0.1192) primarily by rejecting 49 untestable candidates (vs baseline's 70 untestable kept in). Per-candidate confirmed/contradicted ratio is actually slightly WORSE than baseline (11:1 vs 15:1). Hyperloop's lift is structural (fewer untestable noise candidates), not predictive (it doesn't generate more accurate windows).
what_phase1_does_NOT_show: Hyperloop is NOT generating mathematically better hypotheses about RH zeros — the claim windows are auto-generated from candidate_id hashes, not from any reasoning the system performed.
Confirmation does NOT mean the candidate would be a useful step toward proving RH; it means a randomly-chosen window happened to be empty in the table.
Contradiction DOES mean something real: the candidate's lean skeleton commits to a claim that empirical zero data refutes. This is the first non-tautological feedback signal.
next_phases_that_would_produce_real_prog: Phase 2: have Agent A choose claim windows from the candidate's actual reasoning (e.g. de_branges candidates claim windows derived from operator spectrum), not from hash bytes.
Phase 3: replace lean_bridge mock backend with real AXLE Lean kernel — currently sorry-filled skeletons pass `verify_file(backend='mock')` trivially.
Phase 4: when Odlyzko falsifies a claim, that falsification should propagate back into the dead_end_library so the campaign LEARNS to avoid that ingredient combination.
